sections.content: The Google AdSense service we use to serve advertising uses a DoubleClick cookie to serve more relevant ads across the web and limit the number of times a given ad is shown to you. The behavioral advertising cookies used by this site are designed to ensure that you provide the most relevant ads whenever possible by anonymously tracking your interests and presenting similar things that may be of interest to you. Several partners advertise on our behalf and affiliate tracking cookies simply allow us to see if our customers have come to the site through one of our partners' sites so that we can credit them appropriately and where applicable, allow our affiliate partners to offer any promotion that can provide you to make a purchase.

about.title: About Me
about.description: I am passionate about my work as a psychologist, and my background includes projects on child development, body image and lacanian psychoanalysis. I also hold a Master’s degree in clinical psychology from Universidade de São Paulo since 2007, and I am currently employed as an expert psychologist for the Brazilian legal system, working with cases of child adoption and custody disputes. My Certificate of Proficiency in English from Cambridge and my experience as a teacher allow me to perform in English as comfortably as in Portuguese.

book.title: Entre o Espelho e a Tela
book.subtitle: considerações psicanalíticas sobre o uso das tecnologias da informação e comunicação no mundo moderno.
book.author: Published Author

about.content1: With more than 20 years of experience in the area of clinical psychology, I am dedicated to offering humanized and personalized care for each patient.
about.content2: My work is based on Lacanian psychoanalysis, but I incorporate other knowledge and techniques when necessary to meet the specific needs of each case.
about.content3: My mission is to create a safe and welcoming environment where you can explore emotional issues and develop tools to overcome challenges and achieve your personal goals.
about.availability: I am available for online and in-person appointments

services.title: How it works
services.description: Welcoming qualified listening and psychological support when you need it the most.

areas.title: What is psychoanalysis?
areas.description: The method of psychoanalysis works as the patient’s free speech is analyzed in the sessions, allowing unconscious contents and conflicts to emerge. These contents are the means through which new goals and new perspectives can take place in the patient’s life, advancing towards the cure.
areas.quote: Desire, in the psychoanalytic sense, should guide this journey, leading to symptom relief and the establishment of new personal goals, towards healing.
areas.author: Estevam Holpert

listening.title: Analytical Listening
listening.description: Space for free speech, where the patient can express thoughts and feelings without censorship.

unconscious.title: Working with the Unconscious
unconscious.description: Access to unconscious contents that influence behaviors, feelings and choices.

transferencia.title: Transference
transferencia.description: Therapeutic relationship as a field for elaborating fundamental psychological issues.

singularity.title: Singularity
singularity.description: Recognition of each individual's unique and subjective history in the analytical process.
